order_note: No predecessor and no ordering constraint. SQL 125 needs public.deposit_queue_scored, public.deposit_owner_performance, public.deposit_reminder_queue and public.deposit_aging_dashboard (the restored Supabase-era views; spec prerequisites), each a view owned by the applying login (altered_relations_owned_by_login; the file raises sql125_not_view_owner otherwise), with the definitions the spec pins (the supabase migrations' views as PostgreSQL renders them; the fingerprint carries each definition's sha256, so a production view that differs from the reviewed one fails the intended state and the apply rolls back). No API or SPA change: the views stay on the read allowlist and checksops keeps SELECT on them. Adds no trigger and no function: the DB validator is not affected.

tooling.note: Guarded tooling for SQL 125: sql125-deposit-views-security-invoker-production-apply.mjs --inspect (read-only) and the receipt-gated --apply on the engine shared with the staging guarded executor (choice sql125-deposit-views-security-invoker); production-sql-one-shot.mjs --migration sql125. intended_replacement_sha256 is the code-derived fingerprint (releaseIntendedHash in release-sql-state.mjs, equal to the staging pin's): the four views with the reviewed definitions and options security_invoker=true. The view options are fingerprinted with each view (spec views) and left out of the unrelated relations snapshot for these four only (PR #1372). The tooling does not authorize anything: this pin stays execute false until a reviewed change records the staging acceptance, the production inspect and an owner approval.
